title: Cluster Addon Descriptor (addon.yaml)
description: Schema for base addon definitions (clusters/base/addons/*/addon.yaml) and environment overrides (clusters/environments/*/addons/*/addon.yaml) merged by Argo CD Merge Generator.

addon.description: Unique identifier of the addon (merge key). Must match the directory name.

enabled.description: String boolean ('true' or 'false') used by ApplicationSet selector to enable/disable the addon per environment.

kustomize.description: When 'true', attaches Source 3 (Kustomize) pointing to clusters/environments/<env>/addons/<addon> to render raw Kubernetes manifests listed in kustomization.yaml.

namespace.description: Target Kubernetes namespace for this addon.

repoURL.description: Helm repository URL or OCI registry URL.

version.description: Helm chart version (can be overridden per environment to test upgrades in test/preprod before prod).
